DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
cairo:
- '1'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
target_platform:
- linux-64
tk:
- '8.6'

about.description:
Xschem is a schematic capture program, it allows creation of hierarchical
representation of circuits with a top down approach. By focusing on
interfaces, hierarchy and instance properties a complex system can be
described in terms of simpler building blocks. A VHDL or Verilog or Spice
netlist can be generated from the drawn schematic, allowing the simulation
of the circuit. Key feature of the program is its drawing engine written in
C and using directly the Xlib drawing primitives; this gives very good
speed performance, even on very big circuits. The user interface is built
with the Tcl-Tk toolkit, tcl is also the extension language used.
about.summary: Schematic capture and netlisting EDA tool

name: xschem
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "3.4.7"

package:
  name: xschem
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/StefanSchippers/xschem/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8f6c7165c38f528b6cbae8f9fae72cde3b765652df90597011a5f7b5e7fdb273

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - osx
  script:
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: unix
      then:
        - make
        - pkgconf
        - bison
        - flex
    - if: win
      then:
        - winflexbison
  host:
    - tk
    - cairo
    - if: unix
      then:
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libxpm
        - xorg-xorgproto   # X11/X.h and friends (xorg-libx11 does not ship protocol headers)
  run:
    - tk
    - cairo
    - if: unix
      then:
        - xorg-libxpm

tests:
  - script:
      - xschem -v

about:
  homepage: http://repo.hu/projects/xschem/index.html
  repository: https://github.com/StefanSchippers/xschem
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Schematic capture and netlisting EDA tool
  description: |
    Xschem is a schematic capture program, it allows creation of hierarchical
    representation of circuits with a top down approach. By focusing on
    interfaces, hierarchy and instance properties a complex system can be
    described in terms of simpler building blocks. A VHDL or Verilog or Spice
    netlist can be generated from the drawn schematic, allowing the simulation
    of the circuit. Key feature of the program is its drawing engine written in
    C and using directly the Xlib drawing primitives; this gives very good
    speed performance, even on very big circuits. The user interface is built
    with the Tcl-Tk toolkit, tcl is also the extension language used.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duyhieubui
